defs.def: a glass or plastic container, usually round with straight sides and a narrow neck, used especially for storing liquids （细颈）瓶子

ex.s: Even bottled water, scientists found earlier this year, contains 10 to 1,000 times more microplastics than originally thought.
ex.t: ·科学实验室：引导你探索在计算机科学、机器人和物理等关键领域取得成功所需的技能

ex.s: What does the author try to illustrate by mentioning bottled water in paragraph 4?
ex.t: 当他们审视我们的成就时，脑海中会形成"成功"这个金光闪闪的词汇吗？

ex.s: He loved biking around his neighbourhood but grew upset seeing that many plastic bottles littered the parks and sidewalks.
ex.t: 它再次直视我的眼睛，发出一声尖细的鸣叫，然后消失了。

ex.s: “The kids literally come to school with bags of snacks and large bottles of soft drinks,” she says.
ex.t: “孩子们真的是带着一袋袋零食和大瓶软饮料来上学的，”她说。

ex.s: The two of them collected more than 1,000 plastic bottles along the 40-day journey.
ex.t: 两人在40天的旅途中收集了1000多个塑料瓶。

ex.s: That includes cups, bottles, and bags, most of ____18____ are only good for one use.
ex.t: 包括杯子、瓶子和袋子，其中大部分____18____只能使用一次。

ex.s: But it doesn't end with bottles, cans, and paper.
ex.t: 这是处理旧衣服、从朋友那里获得衣服、同时举办聚会的最佳方式。

ex.s: In this way, they know how it feels to walk a long distance carrying heavy bottles.
ex.t: 我出生时就法定失明。

ex.s: Guided tour includes bike, helmet, cookies and bottled water.
ex.t: 时长：3小时（4英里）

ex.s: Tour includes bike, helmet, and bottled water.
ex.t: 旅行包含自行车、头盔和瓶装水。

defs.def: the amount contained in a bottle 一瓶（的量）

ex.s: Bring a personal water bottle, sunscreen, and lunch.
ex.t: 请自带水壶、防晒霜和午餐。

ex.s: It was ___23___ called Mario, coming to ___24___ us a box containing some tomatoes and a bottle of wine.
ex.t: 那是一位___23___名叫马里奥的人，来给我们___24___一个盒子，里面装着一些西红柿和一瓶葡萄酒。

ex.s: Mario’s wine may have been cloudy and come out of an old bottle, but it was ___37___.
ex.t: 马里奥的葡萄酒也许浑浊，还装在旧瓶子里，但它很___37___。

ex.s: As I carried her up the blackberry-lined path toward my car where I kept a water bottle, she began to move.
ex.t: 当我抱着她沿着黑莓丛生的小路走向我的车（车里放着水瓶）时，她开始动了。

ex.s: The bottle is quite difficult to open; the _________ is to pour hot water on it first.
ex.t: 在第1段中，作者提出了__________。

ex.s: He poured water from a bottle into his hand and offered it to my dogs. ______50______, I began to fall for him.
ex.t: 他把瓶里的水倒在手里递给我的狗。______50______，我开始爱上他了。

ex.s: Tom is proud of his design and excited to be selling the Fun Bottle on his website and in stores but this 15-year-old is most proud of the opportunities that Fun Bottle presents to others.
ex.t: Tom对他的设计感到自豪，也很兴奋能在他的网站和商店销售Fun Bottle，但这位15岁少年最引以为豪的是Fun Bottle为他人带来的机会。

ex.s: Where did Tom get the idea for the original model for the Fun Bottle?
ex.t: Tom是从哪里得到Fun Bottle原始设计模型的灵感的？

ex.s: Tom is most proud of the opportunities that Fun Bottle presents to others because he not only provides healthy alternatives to sugary drinks but also donates all the profits to the OHG.
ex.t: Tom最引以为豪Fun Bottle为他人的带来机会是因为他不仅提供了含糖饮料的健康替代品，还将所有利润捐赠给了OHG。

ex.s: From observing his mum and from his desire to give kids better drink options, he came up with his original model for the Fun Bottle.
ex.t: 从观察他妈妈和他想给孩子们更好的饮料选择的愿望出发，他想出了Fun Bottle的原始设计模型。

defs.def: a bottle used to give milk to a baby; the milk from such a bottle (used instead of mother's milk) （婴儿）奶瓶；奶瓶里的奶（非母乳）

ex.s: We had to have a bit of a production line going, making up “tiger milk”, washing baby bottles, and cleaning the floors.
ex.t: 当斑点和条纹四个月大时，它们学会了开门和跳围栏，我们知道真的是时候送它们走了。

defs.def: courage or confidence, for example to do sth that is dangerous or unpleasant 勇气；信心

ex.s: Customers can get 20% off if they buy five bottles or more at a time.
ex.t: 顾客一次购买五瓶或以上可享八折优惠。

ex.s: Carefully pour some hot water into the bottle.
ex.t: 小心地把一些热水倒入瓶中。

ex.s: Then, in 2015, cleaners in an Italian gallery threw away an art piece after mistaking the pile of empty bottles, cigarette ends and pieces of coloured paper for rubbish!
ex.t: 后来在2015年，一家意大利画廊的清洁工把一堆空瓶子、烟头和彩纸误当成垃圾，扔掉了一件艺术品！

ex.s: Such another destruction of ornaments and bottles as the earthquake created, San Francisco never saw before.
ex.t: 旧金山从未见过像地震造成的那样，饰物与瓶罐被毁的另一番景象。

defs.def: to put a liquid into a bottle 把（液体）装入瓶中

ex.s: Quickly put the egg on top of the bottle.
ex.t: 快速把鸡蛋放在瓶口上。

defs.def: to put fruit or vegetables into glass containers in order to preserve them 把（水果或蔬菜等）装入玻璃瓶
